task.title: Add validation preflight and risk-tier policy
task.summary: Add gateway preflight and risk-tier policy so low-risk mechanical/docs cleanup avoids late metadata blocks while high-risk work escalates to user semantic approval.

goal.outcome: Gateways can preflight required metadata/audits/proof before expensive validation and apply risk-tiered user escalation policy.
acceptance: Preflight reports missing upstream builds, audit evidence, task ids, content proof strategy, stale refs, and close/publication blockers before fresh validation handoff.
Risk tiers distinguish mechanical/docs cleanup, code-local, semantic-system, security/migration/publication, and destructive changes.
Low-risk fast path remains gateway-validated and records why user approval is not required beyond accepted semantics.
High-risk categories escalate to user approval before lower-layer promotion.
non_goals: Do not weaken implementation/task-close/publication content-proof requirements.
Do not bypass fresh validation where policy requires independence.
Do not consolidate public tool surface in this task.
verification: Add gateway/preflight tests for missing metadata, fast path eligibility, and escalation categories.
Run validation smoke tests and CodeWiki audits.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from source refs and build handoffs, not prior loop chat memory.
evidence: new session id or recorded context reset

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: codewiki_session_handoff autoQueue=true stages the durable handoff and queues /wiki-session-handoff as an internal follow-up command from the Pi adapter.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/adapters/pi/tools/session-handoff.ts calls queueSessionHandoffFollowUp(pi, result.result.command) when autoQueue is true; tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs asserts deliverAs:"followUp".

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Tool output and prompt guidance no longer tell agents or users to run /wiki-session-handoff manually.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Adapter tool text reports queued internal handoff command; prompt guidance/schema/docs say not to ask users to run /wiki-session-handoff manually.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Context-reset handoffs still avoid direct tool-context compaction while executing through command context after the tool result is visible.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: executeSessionHandoffFromTool still stages context-reset handoffs and smoke test asserts compact is not called from tool context; runSessionHandoffCommand still performs ctx.compact in command context.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Existing /wiki-session-handoff command remains as an internal/compatibility command and direct command smoke behavior still works.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: runSessionHandoffCommand is unchanged for command-context new-session/context-reset execution and package smoke still verifies command registration.

closure_brief.user_intent: Make wiki-session-handoff an internal agent command so agents can run session handoffs without asking users to run /wiki-session-handoff manually, while being mindful of another session working in the repo.
implemented_changes: Pi adapter queues the staged /wiki-session-handoff command as a follow-up when codewiki_session_handoff autoQueue is true.
Tool result text and prompt/schema guidance now describe an internal queued handoff command instead of a user-run command.
System KB and skills describe adapter-owned internal queuing and keep /wiki-session-handoff as an internal/compatibility executor.
Smoke tests cover queued follow-up behavior and preserve direct command execution coverage.
acceptance_evidence: tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs asserts queueSessionHandoffFollowUp sends the staged command with deliverAs:"followUp".
npm run test:smoke passed, including package smoke command registration and session handoff smoke.
non_goals_preserved: Did not implement broader TASK-003 validation preflight/risk-tier work.
Did not change decision-build or diagram-audit task implementations.
remaining_risks: /wiki-session-handoff remains discoverable as a slash command because Pi has no hidden-command flag.

risks: /wiki-session-handoff remains registered as a slash command because Pi command context is required for ctx.newSession/ctx.compact and the API has no hidden-command flag.
